title: Baobab Corporate Relationship and Corporate Group Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Definition library for CorporateRelationship, CorporateGroup and CorporateGroupMembership.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/CorporateRelationship), not the document root.

CorporateRelationship records directed, effective-dated corporate facts between Organisations (source -> target, e.g. 'A OWNS B'). The graph is not a tree: multiple parents, cross-holdings and cycles may exist and must be surfaced, not resolved by guessing.

Invariants (ADR-BCP-018):
  CorporateRelationship != CounterpartyRelationship (ADR-BCP-014)
  CorporateRelationship != ADR-BCP-012 LegalEntityRelationship
  CorporateRelationship != PlatformRelationship
  ownership != control
  CorporateGroup != LegalEntity, != Tenant, != authorization boundary

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

corporateRelationshipType.description: Directed corporate relationship from source_organisation_id to target_organisation_id (ADR-BCP-018 section 18). Inverse facts (owned-by, subsidiary-of, parent-of, sister-of) are derived, never stored. Commercial roles such as SUPPLIER_OF are counterparty facts and do not belong here. Extensible by a versioned contract change.

relationshipStatus.description: Record lifecycle. Evidence state is carried separately by verification_state; an ENDED relationship remains queryable for historical resolution.

CorporateRelationship.description: Platform-scoped, effective-dated corporate fact between two Organisations. Carries no tenant_id. Consequential decisions (e.g. ADR-BCP-017 INTERNAL eligibility) MUST fail closed unless verification_state is VERIFIED. Never a runtime authorization input.

source_organisation_id.description: Subject of the directed fact (e.g. the owner in 'A OWNS B').

target_organisation_id.description: Object of the directed fact (e.g. the owned organisation in 'A OWNS B'). Must differ from source_organisation_id.

ownership_percentage.description: Recorded ownership stake. Never interpreted as control by generic platform code (ADR-BCP-018 section 21). Conflicting evidence moves verification_state to CONFLICTED rather than choosing a value.

control_basis.description: Recorded basis of control (e.g. majority voting rights, board appointment, contractual). Policy, not this field, determines consequences.

direct_or_derived.description: DERIVED facts are projections and must carry basis_relationship_ids (ADR-BCP-018 section 81). Derived facts never silently become source facts.

source_authority.description: Who or what established this record (e.g. shared-governance, admission-review, external-registry). An applicant claim alone never establishes a corporate fact (ADR-BCP-018 section 69).

evidence_references.description: Registry filings, shareholder registers, board records, legal review, etc. Binaries live in a document system.

verified_by.description: Authenticated principal or governed process that performed verification. Server-derived; never accepted from a client payload.

CorporateGroup.description: Economic or governance grouping of Organisations (ADR-BCP-018 section 26). Not a LegalEntity, not the holding company, not a Tenant and not an authorization boundary. A unique root may not exist; root_organisation_id is therefore optional.

root_organisation_id.description: Conventional root, only where one can be established safely. Absent when the ultimate parent is ambiguous.

grouping_policy.description: Identifier and version of the policy that decides membership (e.g. which relationship types and verification states qualify).

CorporateGroupMembership.description: Materialised membership of an Organisation in a CorporateGroup (ADR-BCP-018 section 28). Backed by CorporateRelationship references, or by an explicitly governed manual basis where derivation is impossible. Never a second ownership database; confers no runtime permission.

group_role.description: Descriptive role within the group. Not an IAM role.

manual_basis_reference.description: Governed manual basis, used only where membership cannot be derived from CorporateRelationships.
